claim_constraints.product.identity.definition: minimal target definition only; no inferred sharing counts
claim_constraints.product.identity.product_class: state only that blade servers are also known as high-density servers; do not describe a chassis, enclosure, system, or server blade
claim_constraints.product.form.physical_state: state only that a blade server includes at least one processor and system memory; blade server must be the grammatical subject
claim_constraints.product.reference.flow_identity: say only that blade server is an explicitly defined target term; claim_text must not contain 参考, 流, or 对象
claim_constraints.product.adjacent.distinction: state only that a blade server is designed for use in a blade chassis; blade server must be the grammatical subject; no inferred other-device count
claim_constraints.product.adjacent.specification: direct source-documented target property only; claim_text must not contain 分类, 维度, or 类型
claim_constraints.product.scope.exclusions: blade server must be the grammatical subject; state only its operating dependency boundary; adjacent object must not be the subject
